script: A man once sold thousands of people land in a country that didn't exist. He made them pay for the trip there themselves. In 1822, a Scottish adventurer named Gregor MacGregor arrived in London. He claimed to be the Cacique of Poyais, a wealthy nation on the Mosquito Coast of Central America. He sold government bonds on the London Stock Exchange. He printed official Poyaisian currency. He published a glossy guidebook describing fertile farmland and a welcoming government. Roughly two hundred and fifty people sold their belongings. They sailed across the Atlantic to start new lives there. When they arrived, they found only untouched jungle. No roads. No buildings. No government of any kind. Disease and starvation killed nearly a third of the settlers within months. The rest were rescued by a passing ship. MacGregor fled back to London. He tried the exact same scheme in France. He was eventually put on trial, and walked free on a legal technicality. A man once invented an entire country. He sold it to thousands of people, and got away with it completely.

title: A Man Once Sold an Entire Country That Didn't Exist
description:
In 1822, Gregor MacGregor convinced London investors and settlers that a rich nation called Poyais existed in Central America. It didn't. Almost a third of the settlers died before rescue.

Did you know this actually happened? Let me know in the comments.
